rich2021TaskDetails: Original IM2021 G5 U08:L17 asks learners to DESIGN fraction True/False prompts with supporting calculations and plausible errors, so originality and explanation are central to the source activity.
Warm-up source three statements:3/4+3/8=3/8+3/8 FALSE because9/8≠6/8;7/5+2/3=21/15+8/15 FALSE because2/3=10/15;8/9+5/12=32/36+15/36 TRUE.

Activity1 True or False Design1 includes original5/6−4/9=45/54−24/54 TRUE, and5/6−4/9=15/36 FALSE (correct difference7/18=14/36). Pupils write another equation, label it and explain which misconception it might expose.
Activity2 Design2 starts8/14+3/7=4/7+3/7 TRUE, then students write TWO further original statements with different instructional purposes and valid fractional equivalence.

Activity3 Design3 asks students to CREATE THREE independent True/False statements and explain their reasoning. No deterministic student responses should be invented and marked publisher original. Selected exact cases only cover seven printed source fixed judgments; teacher assesses the generated task quality.
